description: Create, read, consume and cancel the confirmation requests (network.confirmation-request@1) of the agents that use this service's sensitive capabilities (roadmap WS-Z2, docs/t2-projects-and-grants.md section 5). The owning service writes the summary and the request digest; Network derives the owner from the agent and re-checks the agent, its grant and its host's authority on consume. A service only ever sees confirmations whose audience is its own. Never grantable to apps or agents.
